gloss: to keep watch; to stand guard

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見張|みは}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to keep watch; to stand guard; to look out
definitions.explanation: To watch carefully over a place, person, or situation in order to protect, monitor, or prevent something from happening. Implies sustained, vigilant observation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見張|みは}って⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please keep watch over the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見張|みは}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Security guards are keeping watch around the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{見張|みは}ってい⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: While the children are playing in the pool, parents must keep a close watch.

notes:
USAGE:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}). The noun form ⟦{見張|みは}り→見張り：18525_mihari⟧ means 'lookout, watch, guard.' Can describe both security/guarding situations and everyday supervision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{見張|みは}り→見張り：18525_mihari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to post a lookout)
- ⟦{見張|みは}り→見張り：18525_mihari⟧⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ (watchman, guard)
- ⟦{見張|みは}り→見張り：18525_mihari⟧{台|だい} (watchtower, lookout post)
- ⟦{見張|みは}り→見張り：18525_mihari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand guard)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{監視|かんし}→監視：05521_kanshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to monitor, to surveil — more formal; often implies systematic or technological surveillance
- ⟦{見守|みまも}る→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧: to watch over — gentler; implies protective, caring observation
